title: Woman in her 20s dies after collapsing during Seoul Race half-marathon

blocks.text: A woman in her 20s died after collapsing just short of the finish line at the 2026 Seoul Race half-marathon on Sunday, event organizers said last Monday. The runner collapsed at 8:49 a.m. near the 20.6-kilometer mark, about 500 meters from the finish line, according to the organizing committee. She received CPR at the scene
